bitcoin_articles.headline: Strive, Inc. Acquires 1,210 Bitcoin for Approximately $89 Million
bitcoin_articles.summary: Strive, Inc. has expanded its corporate Bitcoin treasury with the acquisition of 1,210 Bitcoin, valued at approximately $89 million.

bitcoin_articles.headline: Bitdeer Maintains Zero Bitcoin Treasury Policy with Sale of 206.2 BTC
bitcoin_articles.summary: Bitdeer Technologies Group has sold 206.2 BTC, representing its entire mining production for the week ending May 29, 2026, to maintain its zero-balance treasury strategy.

bitcoin_articles.headline: CleanSpark President and CFO Gary A. Vecchiarelli Appointed to Texas Strategic Bitcoin Reserve Advisory Committee
bitcoin_articles.summary: CleanSpark, Inc. President and CFO Gary A. Vecchiarelli has been appointed as one of four external experts to the Texas Strategic Bitcoin Reserve Advisory Committee.
